fixes.what: Wrapper source_encodings.filed_rate_reading all_in -> cash_leg. The page prints 'x % Cash, y % PIK' and the filer tags x with InvestmentInterestRate and y with InvestmentInterestRatePaidInKind; x is the reference rate plus the margin, so the tag is the cash leg and the all-in coupon is x + y. Under all_in the build published x as all-in and x - y as cash, and no rate where y > x (Amalfi; the 13 financial_convention_unresolved findings). 20 to 31 rows a quarter in all 13 quarters; page compare: rate differs from cash + PIK on 301 rows (bpxa) -> 20 (bpxc).
